# Aurral

> Self-hosted music discovery server. Reads your library and listening history, builds
> personalised recommendations and scheduled playlist flows, then downloads the tracks to
> your own music server. Works alongside Lidarr or entirely standalone.

Site: https://www.aurral.com

## Feature documentation

- [Overview](https://www.aurral.com/features): every feature in one place
- [Discover: how recommendations are built](https://www.aurral.com/discover): seed artists, ranking, discovery modes
- [Flows: scheduled playlist flows](https://www.aurral.com/flows): source mix, Focus, Deep Dive
- [Playlists and imports](https://www.aurral.com/playlists): Spotify, YouTube Music, Last.fm, ListenBrainz, JSON
- [Quality profiles and upgrades](https://www.aurral.com/quality): FLAC and MP3 tiers, cutoff, file verification
- [Getting started with Docker Compose](https://www.aurral.com/getting-started): one container, one port
- [All integrations](https://www.aurral.com/integrations): 15 integrations across 5 groups
- [Glossary](https://www.aurral.com/glossary): 15 terms defined plainly

## Integrations

### Library

- [Lidarr](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/lidarr): optional. Hand artist and album management over, keep discovery on Aurral.
- [MusicBrainz](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/musicbrainz): canonical release metadata and the artist identifiers everything keys on.

### Downloads

- [slskd / Soulseek](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/slskd): peer-to-peer client with an HTTP API Aurral can drive.
- [yt-dlp](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/yt-dlp): pulls audio from sources that expose a direct URL. Never used for upgrades.
- [deemix](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/deemix): downloads land in review more often, because identity is harder to prove.
- [Usenet](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/usenet): SABnzbd and NZBGet, driven through their queue APIs.

### Playback

- [Navidrome](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/navidrome): playlist publishing plus Subsonic compatibility for every client.
- [Plex](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/plex): playlists land in the playlist owner's own Plex account.
- [Jellyfin](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/jellyfin): published as a private playlist under the matching Jellyfin user.
- [Subsonic clients](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/subsonic): the /rest endpoint that makes phone apps work.

### Listening history

- [Last.fm](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/lastfm): better similar-artist matches than any keyless alternative.
- [ListenBrainz](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/listenbrainz): keyless by default. Great for scrobbling, weaker for similarity.
- [Koito](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/koito): point Aurral at a self-hosted Koito URL and read history from there.

### Alerts and shows

- [Ticketmaster](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/ticketmaster): nearby concerts for artists in your library.
- [Notifications](https://www.aurral.com/integrations/notifications): Gotify and generic webhooks for flow completion and new releases.

## Use cases

### Setting up

- [Installing Aurral for the first time](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/first-install): the whole path in order
- [Fixing media path mounts](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/media-paths): why Aurral does not see the music Lidarr sees
- [Planning disk for lossless](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/disk-planning): what a quality profile actually costs
- [Fixing UID and GID problems](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/permissions): why downloads are unreadable after the container writes them
- [Behind a reverse proxy](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/reverse-proxy): HTTPS with SSO, and the address mismatch that breaks phone apps
- [Listening from your phone](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/remote-playback): app passwords, the connect QR code, Subsonic clients

### Getting more out of it

- [When your library stopped being fun](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/library-too-big): 40,000 tracks and the same forty played
- [Going deeper without the slop](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/dig-deeper): Deep Dive, Focus and discovery modes together
- [Building a flow around one decade](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/decades): year ranges and why they only apply to Focus
- [A weekly routine that runs itself](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/weekly-refresh): make it feel like Discover Weekly
- [Never miss a new album again](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/new-releases): monitoring, the Inbox, release feeds

### Moving and sharing

- [Moving off Spotify](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/leave-spotify): what breaks when you cancel, and what cannot be replaced
- [Importing playlists from other services](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/import-playlists): what each provider gives you
- [Moving to a new machine](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/move-hosts): migrate without re-downloading anything
- [Sharing one library with other people](https://www.aurral.com/scenarios/multi-user): per-user taste over a shared library

## Comparisons

- [Aurral vs Lidarr](https://www.aurral.com/compare/lidarr): which one handles music discovery
- [Aurral vs Spotify](https://www.aurral.com/compare/spotify): owning the catalogue or renting it
- [Aurral vs Navidrome](https://www.aurral.com/compare/navidrome): discovery layer or music server
- [Aurral vs Jellyseerr for music](https://www.aurral.com/compare/jellyseerr): requests or discovery

## Free browser tools

- [Spotify CSV to JSON converter](https://www.aurral.com/tools/spotify-csv-converter): convert an Exportify CSV for playlist import
- [Flow size calculator](https://www.aurral.com/tools/playlist-calculator): the right track count for your library
- [Quality profile advisor](https://www.aurral.com/tools/quality-advisor): FLAC vs MP3 cost in disk and bandwidth
- [Lidarr custom list builder](https://www.aurral.com/tools/lidarr-feed-builder): compose the feed URL and public address
